name: year
description: Reference year of the index value

name: quarter
description: Reference quarter of the index value

name: place_id
description: Place code: USA for the United States, or DV_ plus the Census division abbreviation

name: place_name
description: Name of the United States or of the Census division

name: index_type
description: Index variant: traditional, developmental, distress-free, non-metro or manufactured
observations: The traditional purchase-only seasonally adjusted index is the series FHFA reports in its press releases. non-metro covers the nonmetropolitan remainder of a state rather than the state as a whole; manufactured covers manufactured homes only.

name: index_flavor
description: Underlying transaction data: purchase-only, all-transactions or expanded-data
observations: The three flavours differ by the data feeding the repeat-sales regression, not by the statistical method. Only all-transactions runs before 1991.

name: index_nsa
description: House price index, not seasonally adjusted
observations: The first period of each series is set to 100

name: index_sa
observations: Null wherever FHFA publishes no seasonally adjusted variant of the series
